name: Kyo-to (Kyoto Japanese Dining)
address: 119 C. Palanca St, Legazpi Village, Makati, Metro Manila
curatedNote: 站長私藏！馬尼拉 Makati 極具水準的無菜單懷石割烹料理，食材旬味處理細緻，需提前預約。
description: 位於馬尼拉金融區的高級預約制正統懷石料理，主廚專注於呈現日本當令食材的極致原味。

descriptions.zh-TW: 位於馬尼拉金融區的高級預約制正統懷石料理，主廚專注於呈現日本當令食材的極致原味，氛圍靜謐雅緻。
descriptions.en: Exclusive Japanese Kaiseki restaurant in Makati offering authentic multi-course seasonal dining with exquisite craft.
descriptions.tl: Eksklusibong Japanese Kaiseki restaurant sa Makati na may tunay na seasonal multi-course dining.

name: The Backyard Butcher Davao

names.zh-TW: The Backyard Butcher (煙燻牛排私房菜)

address: GSIS Heights, Matina, Talomo, Davao City, Davao del Sur
curatedNote: 站長親自認證！達沃隱藏在半山丘的私房牛排肉舖，16呎低溫慢火柴燒煙燻牛胸肉與精選牛排極致多汁美味。
description: 達沃老饕私藏的煙燻美式柴烤牛排與精選肉舖，招牌煙燻牛胸肉（Smoked Brisket）與炭烤肋眼鮮嫩多汁。

descriptions.zh-TW: 達沃老饕私藏的煙燻美式柴烤牛排與精選肉舖，招牌煙燻牛胸肉（Smoked Brisket）與炭烤肋眼鮮嫩多汁，香氣濃郁。
descriptions.en: Artisanal steakhouse and smokehouse in Matina, famous for slow-smoked brisket, prime ribeye, and house rubs.
descriptions.tl: Sikat na smokehouse at steakhouse sa Matina, kilala sa malambot na smoked brisket at inihaw na karne.

name: Yaki2gether (Yaki Together)
curatedNote: 站長私房愛店！達沃高水準生魚片刺身、特色日式捲壽司與炭火燒物，食材新鮮、聚會小酌絕佳首選。
description: 達沃當地廣受歡迎的高品質日式燒烤與壽司料理，主打新鮮現切生魚片刺身、特色壽司捲與炭烤串燒。

descriptions.zh-TW: 達沃當地廣受歡迎的高品質日式燒烤與壽司料理，主打新鮮現切生魚片刺身、特色壽司捲與炭烤串燒，性價比極高。
descriptions.en: Popular Japanese spot in Davao offering super-fresh sashimi, specialty sushi rolls, and savory charcoal yakitori.
descriptions.tl: Kilalang Japanese restaurant sa Davao na naghahain ng sariwang sashimi, sushi rolls, at masarap na yakitori.
